coder_notes: Paediatric/young adult (<=30 y) basket of relapsed/refractory solid and CNS tumours; mixed_age. GBM only named within the DIPG cohort histology list, flagged uncertain for S5. Repotrectinib is the only investigational agent; irinotecan + temozolomide registered as one intervention, split into two soc_backbone rows (shared regimen_id, not a fixed-dose product). DIPG cohort receives repotrectinib monotherapy per arm description even though the registry links irinotecan/temozolomide to that arm, so backbone arms exclude the DIPG cohort. ALK/ROS/NTRK testing is required in phase 2 but fusions are not required (permitted only), so coded exploratory_correlative. H3K27M appears only as one acceptable diagnosis for atypical pontine tumours, not an entry requirement; not recorded. PK planned without stated sample type, so tumour_pk_planned unclear.
